--[[
    ERASED DEX
    Made by imonstxrz
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()

local Theme = {
    Primary = Color3.fromHex("#ff0032"),
    Background = Color3.fromHex("#050505"),
    Surface = Color3.fromHex("#0f0f0f"),
    Card = Color3.fromHex("#141414"),
    Text = Color3.fromHex("#e5e2e1"),
    TextDim = Color3.fromHex("#888888"),
    Border = Color3.fromHex("#1a1a1a")
}

local State = {
    NormalFly = false,
    AnimFly = false,
    Speed = 16,
    NoClip = false,
    TouchFling = false,
    Attach = false,
    KillAura = false,
    TargetLock = false,
    AntiFling = false,
    Target = nil,
    FlyConn = nil,
    AnimFlyConn = nil,
    AttachConn = nil,
    NoClipConn = nil,
    KillAuraConn = nil,
    AntiFlingConn = nil
}

if game.CoreGui:FindFirstChild("ErasedDex") then
    game.CoreGui.ErasedDex:Destroy()
end

local Gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
Gui.Name = "ErasedDex"
Gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
Gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
Gui.Parent = game.CoreGui

local Main = Instance.new("Frame")
Main.Size = UDim2.new(0, 340, 0, 660)
Main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -170, 0.5, -330)
Main.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background
Main.BorderSizePixel = 0
Main.Active = true
Main.Draggable = true
Main.Parent = Gui
Instance.new("UICorner", Main).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

local Stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
Stroke.Color = Theme.Primary
Stroke.Thickness = 2
Stroke.Parent = Main

-- Header
local Header = Instance.new("Frame")
Header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 78)
Header.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Surface
Header.BorderSizePixel = 0
Header.Parent = Main
Instance.new("UICorner", Header).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

local HeaderFix = Instance.new("Frame")
HeaderFix.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12)
HeaderFix.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -12)
HeaderFix.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Surface
HeaderFix.BorderSizePixel = 0
HeaderFix.Parent = Header

local Logo = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Logo.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 22)
Logo.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 8)
Logo.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Logo.Text = "welcome to erased menu by imonstxrz"
Logo.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Logo.TextSize = 13
Logo.TextColor3 = Theme.Primary
Logo.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
Logo.Parent = Header

local Sub = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Sub.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
Sub.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 32)
Sub.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Sub.Text = "ERASED DEX"
Sub.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
Sub.TextSize = 20
Sub.TextColor3 = Theme.Primary
Sub.Parent = Header

local Close = Instance.new("TextButton")
Close.Size = UDim2.new(0, 26, 0, 26)
Close.Position = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 8)
Close.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Close.Text = "×"
Close.TextColor3 = Theme.Primary
Close.TextSize = 20
Close.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Close.Parent = Header
Close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() Gui:Destroy() end)

-- Content
local Content = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
Content.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -115)
Content.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 86)
Content.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Content.BorderSizePixel = 0
Content.ScrollBarThickness = 3
Content.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Theme.Primary
Content.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 950)
Content.Parent = Main

local List = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
List.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
List.Parent = Content

-- Helpers
local function Section(text)
    local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    l.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
    l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    l.Text = text
    l.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    l.TextSize = 12
    l.TextColor3 = Theme.Primary
    l.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    l.Parent = Content
end

local function Toggle(name, desc, callback)
    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Card
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.Parent = Content
    Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Color = Theme.Border
    stroke.Thickness = 1
    stroke.Parent = frame

    local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 18)
    title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 7)
    title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    title.Text = name
    title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    title.TextSize = 14
    title.TextColor3 = Theme.Text
    title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    title.Parent = frame

    local sub = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    sub.Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 14)
    sub.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 27)
    sub.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    sub.Text = desc
    sub.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    sub.TextSize = 11
    sub.TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim
    sub.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    sub.Parent = frame

    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 42, 0, 22)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -52, 0.5, -11)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35)
    btn.Text = ""
    btn.Parent = frame
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
    knob.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16)
    knob.Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -8)
    knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 120)
    knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
    knob.Parent = btn
    Instance.new("UICorner", knob).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local on = false
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        on = not on
        if on then
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Primary
            knob.Position = UDim2.new(1, -19, 0.5, -8)
            knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
            stroke.Color = Theme.Primary
        else
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35)
            knob.Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -8)
            knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 120)
            stroke.Color = Theme.Border
        end
        callback(on)
    end)
end

local function Slider(name, min, max, default, callback)
    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 60)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Card
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.Parent = Content
    Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Color = Theme.Border
    stroke.Thickness = 1
    stroke.Parent = frame

    local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    title.Size = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 0, 18)
    title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 6)
    title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    title.Text = name
    title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    title.TextSize = 14
    title.TextColor3 = Theme.Text
    title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    title.Parent = frame

    local val = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    val.Size = UDim2.new(0.25, 0, 0, 18)
    val.Position = UDim2.new(0.72, 0, 0, 6)
    val.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    val.Text = tostring(default)
    val.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    val.TextSize = 13
    val.TextColor3 = Theme.Primary
    val.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
    val.Parent = frame

    local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
    bar.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 5)
    bar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 38)
    bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
    bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
    bar.Parent = frame
    Instance.new("UICorner", bar).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    fill.Size = UDim2.new((default-min)/(max-min), 0, 1, 0)
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Primary
    fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fill.Parent = bar
    Instance.new("UICorner", fill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local dragging = false
    bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = true end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = false end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
        if dragging and i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            local rel = math.clamp((i.Position.X - bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / bar.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
            local v = math.floor(min + (max-min)*rel)
            fill.Size = UDim2.new(rel, 0, 1, 0)
            val.Text = tostring(v)
            callback(v)
        end
    end)
end

local function Button(name, callback)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Card
    btn.Text = name
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    btn.TextSize = 14
    btn.TextColor3 = Theme.Text
    btn.Parent = Content
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Color = Theme.Border
    stroke.Thickness = 1
    stroke.Parent = btn

    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
    btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        stroke.Color = Theme.Primary
        btn.TextColor3 = Theme.Primary
    end)
    btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        stroke.Color = Theme.Border
        btn.TextColor3 = Theme.Text
    end)
end

-- Player List + Target
local PlayerListFrame = nil
local SelectedLabel = nil

local function SetTarget(plr)
    State.Target = plr
    if SelectedLabel then
        if plr then
            SelectedLabel.Text = "Selected: " .. plr.Name
            SelectedLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.Primary
        else
            SelectedLabel.Text = "Selected: None"
            SelectedLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim
        end
    end
end

local function RefreshPlayerList()
    if not PlayerListFrame then return end
    for _, child in ipairs(PlayerListFrame:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("TextButton") then child:Destroy() end
    end
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer then
            local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
            btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 28)
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
            btn.Text = plr.Name
            btn.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
            btn.TextSize = 13
            btn.TextColor3 = Theme.Text
            btn.Parent = PlayerListFrame
            Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
            btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                SetTarget(plr)
            end)
        end
    end
end

-- ======================
-- BUILD UI
-- ======================

Section("MOVEMENT")

Toggle("Normal Fly", "Classic flight", function(on)
    State.NormalFly = on
    if State.AnimFly then return end
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hum or not root then return end
    if on then
        hum.PlatformStand = true
        local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        bv.Name = "ED_Fly"
        bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9,9e9,9e9)
        bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
        bv.Parent = root
        local bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
        bg.Name = "ED_Gyro"
        bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9,9e9,9e9)
        bg.P = 10000
        bg.Parent = root
        State.FlyConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not State.NormalFly then return end
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            local dir = Vector3.zero
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then dir += cam.CFrame.LookVector end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then dir -= cam.CFrame.LookVector end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then dir -= cam.CFrame.RightVector end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then dir += cam.CFrame.RightVector end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then dir += Vector3.yAxis end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then dir -= Vector3.yAxis end
            if dir.Magnitude > 0 then dir = dir.Unit * 50 end
            bv.Velocity = dir
            bg.CFrame = cam.CFrame
        end)
    else
        if State.FlyConn then State.FlyConn:Disconnect() State.FlyConn = nil end
        hum.PlatformStand = false
        if root:FindFirstChild("ED_Fly") then root.ED_Fly:Destroy() end
        if root:FindFirstChild("ED_Gyro") then root.ED_Gyro:Destroy() end
    end
end)

Toggle("Animated Fly", "Fly with cool animation", function(on)
    State.AnimFly = on
    if State.NormalFly then return end
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hum or not root then return end
    if on then
        hum.PlatformStand = true
        local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        bv.Name = "ED_AnimFly"
        bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9,9e9,9e9)
        bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
        bv.Parent = root
        local bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
        bg.Name = "ED_AnimGyro"
        bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9,9e9,9e9)
        bg.P = 3000
        bg.Parent = root
        local angle = 0
        State.AnimFlyConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
            if not State.AnimFly then return end
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            local dir = Vector3.zero
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then dir += cam.CFrame.LookVector end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then dir -= cam.CFrame.LookVector end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then dir -= cam.CFrame.RightVector end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then dir += cam.CFrame.RightVector end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then dir += Vector3.yAxis end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then dir -= Vector3.yAxis end
            if dir.Magnitude > 0 then dir = dir.Unit * 55; angle = angle + dt * 8 else angle = angle + dt * 2 end
            bv.Velocity = dir
            bg.CFrame = cam.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(math.sin(angle)*15), 0, math.rad(math.cos(angle)*25))
        end)
    else
        if State.AnimFlyConn then State.AnimFlyConn:Disconnect() State.AnimFlyConn = nil end
        hum.PlatformStand = false
        if root:FindFirstChild("ED_AnimFly") then root.ED_AnimFly:Destroy() end
        if root:FindFirstChild("ED_AnimGyro") then root.ED_AnimGyro:Destroy() end
    end
end)

Slider("Speed", 16, 250, 16, function(v)
    State.Speed = v
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
        char.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = v
    end
end)

Toggle("NoClip", "Walk through walls", function(on)
    State.NoClip = on
    if on then
        State.NoClipConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
            if not State.NoClip then return end
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            if char then
                for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                    if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.CanCollide = false end
                end
            end
        end)
    else
        if State.NoClipConn then State.NoClipConn:Disconnect() State.NoClipConn = nil end
    end
end)

-- Anti Fling
Toggle("Anti Fling", "Stops other players from flinging you", function(on)
    State.AntiFling = on
    if on then
        State.AntiFlingConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
            if not State.AntiFling then return end
            for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character then
                    for _, part in ipairs(plr.Character:GetChildren()) do
                        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                            part.CanCollide = false
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    else
        if State.AntiFlingConn then
            State.AntiFlingConn:Disconnect()
            State.AntiFlingConn = nil
        end
        -- Restore collision
        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character then
                for _, part in ipairs(plr.Character:GetChildren()) do
                    if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                        part.CanCollide = true
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

Section("PLAYER LIST")

SelectedLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
SelectedLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)

SelectedLabel.Text = "Selected: None"

Instance.new("UICorner", PlayerListFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

listPad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4)

listPad.Parent = PlayerListFrame

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function() task.wait(0.3) RefreshPlayerList() end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function()
    task.wait(0.1)
    RefreshPlayerList()
    if State.Target and not State.Target.Parent then SetTarget(nil) end

Button("Refresh Player List", function() RefreshPlayerList() end)

Section("ACTIONS")

Toggle("Target Lock", "Auto lock when you click near someone", function(on)
    State.TargetLock = on
end)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
    if gp or not State.TargetLock then return end
    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then return end

    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local ray = cam:ScreenPointToRay(Mouse.X, Mouse.Y)
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {char}
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

    local result = workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * 50, params)
    if result and result.Instance then
        local model = result.Instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
        if model then
            local plr = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
            if plr and plr ~= LocalPlayer then
                SetTarget(plr)
                return
            end

local character, humanoid, rootPart, rootJoint
local originalRootC0 = CFrame.new()

local jumpOffset = 0
local jumpVelocity = 0

local function setupCharacter(char)
 character = char
 humanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
 rootPart = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 
 rootJoint = rootPart:FindFirstChild("RootJoint") 
  or (char:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso") and char.LowerTorso:FindFirstChild("RootJoint"))
 
 if rootJoint then
  originalRootC0 = rootJoint.C0
 end

 humanoid.StateChanged:Connect(function(_, newState)
  if newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
   jumpVelocity = -0.15
  elseif newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed then
   local fallSpeed = math.abs(rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y)
   local impact = math.clamp(fallSpeed / 35, 0.15, 0.45)
   jumpVelocity = -impact
  end
 end)
end

if player.Character then setupCharacter(player.Character) end
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(setupCharacter)

local WALK_INTENSITY = 0.16
local WALK_FREQ = 10

local RUN_INTENSITY = 0.30
local RUN_FREQ = 14

local TILT_INTENSITY = 0.06
local LERP_SPEED = 0.18

local tickCounter = 0
local lastCameraRotation = camera.CFrame
local currentCameraTilt = 0
local currentBobOffset = Vector3.new()
local currentBodyTilt = Vector3.new()

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)
 if not humanoid or not rootPart or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end

 local velocity = rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
 local currentSpeed = velocity.Magnitude
 local isGrounded = humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air

 if currentSpeed > 0.5 and isGrounded then
  local isRunning = currentSpeed > 18
  local intensity = isRunning and RUN_INTENSITY or WALK_INTENSITY
  local freq = isRunning and RUN_FREQ or WALK_FREQ

  tickCounter += deltaTime * freq

  local bobX = math.cos(tickCounter * 0.5) * (intensity * 0.65)
  local bobY = math.abs(math.sin(tickCounter)) * intensity

  currentBobOffset = currentBobOffset:Lerp(Vector3.new(bobX, bobY, 0), LERP_SPEED)
 else
  tickCounter = 0
  currentBobOffset = currentBobOffset:Lerp(Vector3.new(), LERP_SPEED)
 end

 local springStiffness = 180
 local springDamping = 12
 local force = -springStiffness * jumpOffset - springDamping * jumpVelocity
 jumpVelocity += force * deltaTime
 jumpOffset += jumpVelocity * deltaTime

 local deltaCFrame = camera.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(lastCameraRotation)
 local _, yawDelta = deltaCFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
 lastCameraRotation = camera.CFrame

 currentCameraTilt = currentCameraTilt + (targetCamTilt - currentCameraTilt) * LERP_SPEED

 camera.CFrame = camera.CFrame

  * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, currentCameraTilt)

 if rootJoint then
  local localVel = rootPart.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(velocity)
  
  local targetBodyX = -localVel.Z * 0.015
  local targetBodyZ = localVel.X * 0.015
  local targetBodyY = -yawDelta * 0.5

  currentBodyTilt = currentBodyTilt:Lerp(Vector3.new(targetBodyX, targetBodyY, targetBodyZ), LERP_SPEED)

  local bodyBobY = (currentBobOffset.Y * 0.5) + (jumpOffset * 0.7)
  local bodyBobX = currentBobOffset.X * 0.3

}

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local function createESP(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then return end

    local box = Drawing.new("Square")
    box.Visible = false
    box.Thickness = 1.5
    box.Filled = false

    local tracer = Drawing.new("Line")
    tracer.Visible = false
    tracer.Thickness = 1

    local name = Drawing.new("Text")
    name.Visible = false
    name.Size = 14
    name.Center = true
    name.Outline = true

    local connection
    connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        local character = player.Character
        if character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") and character.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
            
    
            local cframe, size = character:GetBoundingBox()
            local hrpPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(cframe.Position)

            if onScreen then
       
                local topPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint((cframe * CFrame.new(0, size.Y / 2, 0)).Position)
                local bottomPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint((cframe * CFrame.new(0, -size.Y / 2, 0)).Position)

                local height = math.abs(topPos.Y - bottomPos.Y)
                local width = height * 0.65

                -- 1. Box ESP
                if ESP.Boxes then
                    box.Size = Vector2.new(width, height)
                    box.Position = Vector2.new(hrpPos.X - width / 2, topPos.Y)
                    box.Color = ESP.BoxColor
                    box.Visible = true
                else
                    box.Visible = false
                end

                -- 2. Tracer ESP
                if ESP.Tracers then
                    tracer.From = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y)
                    tracer.To = Vector2.new(hrpPos.X, bottomPos.Y)
                    tracer.Color = ESP.TracerColor
                    tracer.Visible = true
                else
                    tracer.Visible = false
                end

                -- 3. Name ESP
                if ESP.Names then
                    name.Position = Vector2.new(hrpPos.X, topPos.Y - 16)
                    name.Text = player.DisplayName or player.Name
                    name.Color = ESP.NameColor
                    name.Visible = true
                else
                    name.Visible = false
                end
            else
                box.Visible = false
                tracer.Visible = false
                name.Visible = false
            end
        else
            box.Visible = false
            tracer.Visible = false
            name.Visible = false

            if not Players:FindFirstChild(player.Name) then
                box:Remove()
                tracer:Remove()
                name:Remove()
                connection:Disconnect()
            end
        end
    end)
end

end

-- Скрипт полёта с красивым синим огнём
-- Создаёт эффект синего пламени при полёте

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

-- Настройки
local Settings = {
    FlySpeed = 50,
    ToggleKey = Enum.KeyCode.F,  -- Клавиша для включения/выключения
    FireSize = 5,
    FireColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 255),
    FireTransparency = 0.3,
    TrailEnabled = true
}

-- Переменные
local isFlying = false
local flyConnection = nil
local fireEffects = {}
local trailEffect = nil

-- Функция создания огня
local function createFire(parent, position)
    local fire = Instance.new("Fire")
    fire.Size = Settings.FireSize
    fire.Color = Settings.FireColor
    fire.SecondaryColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 200)
    fire.Heat = 15
    fire.Parent = parent
    
    return fire
end

-- Функция создания эффекта следа
local function createTrail()
    local trail = Instance.new("Trail")
    trail.Color = Color3.new(0, 0.6, 1)
    trail.Lifetime = 1
    trail.MinLength = 1
    trail.MaxLength = 10
    trail.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0, 1)
    trail.Parent = rootPart
    return trail
end

-- Функция создания эффектов полёта
local function createFlyEffects()
    -- Огонь на ногах
    local leftFoot = character:FindFirstChild("LeftFoot")
    local rightFoot = character:FindFirstChild("RightFoot")
    
    if leftFoot then
        local fire = createFire(leftFoot, Vector3.new(0, -1, 0))
        table.insert(fireEffects, fire)
    end
    
    if rightFoot then
        local fire = createFire(rightFoot, Vector3.new(0, -1, 0))
        table.insert(fireEffects, fire)
    end
    
    -- Огонь под персонажем
    local groundFire = Instance.new("Part")
    groundFire.Name = "FlyFirePart"
    groundFire.Size = Vector3.new(3, 0.5, 3)
    groundFire.Transparency = 0
    groundFire.CanCollide = false
    groundFire.Anchored = true
    groundFire.Parent = character
    
    local fire = createFire(groundFire, Vector3.new(0, 0, 0))
    table.insert(fireEffects, fire)
    
    -- След
    if Settings.TrailEnabled then
        trailEffect = createTrail()
    end
end

-- Функция удаления эффектов
local function removeFlyEffects()
    for _, fire in ipairs(fireEffects) do
        if fire and fire.Parent then
            fire:Destroy()
        end
    end
    fireEffects = {}
    
    if trailEffect then
        trailEffect:Destroy()
        trailEffect = nil
    end
    
    local groundFire = character:FindFirstChild("FlyFirePart")
    if groundFire then
        groundFire:Destroy()
    end
end

-- Функция включения полёта
local function startFly()
    if isFlying then return end
    
    isFlying = true
    createFlyEffects()
    
    -- Включаем невесомость
    humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Flying)
    humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Falling, false)
    humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping, false)
    
    -- Управление полётом
    flyConnection = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
        if not isFlying then return end
        
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local moveDirection = Vector3.new()
        
        -- Получаем ввод
        local keyboard = game:GetService("UserInputService")
        
        if keyboard:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
            moveDirection = moveDirection + camera.CFrame.LookVector
        end
        if keyboard:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
            moveDirection = moveDirection - camera.CFrame.LookVector
        end
        if keyboard:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
            moveDirection = moveDirection - camera.CFrame.RightVector
        end
        if keyboard:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
            moveDirection = moveDirection + camera.CFrame.RightVector
        end
        if keyboard:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
            moveDirection = moveDirection + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end
        if keyboard:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
            moveDirection = moveDirection - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end
        
        -- Нормализуем направление
        if moveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
            moveDirection = moveDirection.Unit * Settings.FlySpeed * deltaTime
            rootPart.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame + moveDirection
        end
        
        -- Обновляем позицию огня
        local groundFire = character:FindFirstChild("FlyFirePart")
        if groundFire then
            groundFire.CFrame = CFrame.new(rootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, -2, 0))
        end
        
        -- Анимация огня
        for _, fire in ipairs(fireEffects) do
            if fire and fire.Parent then
                fire.Size = Settings.FireSize + math.sin(tick() * 5) * 0.5
            end
        end
    end)
    
    -- Визуальный эффект запуска
    local particles = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
    particles.Name = "FlyParticles"
    particles.Color = ColorSequence.new(Settings.FireColor)
    particles.Size = NumberSequence.new(1, 3)
    particles.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1)
    particles.Rate = 50
    particles.Speed = NumberRange.new(5, 10)
    particles.Parent = rootPart
    
    -- Эффект свечения
    local pointLight = Instance.new("PointLight")
    pointLight.Color = Settings.FireColor
    pointLight.Brightness = 5
    pointLight.Range = 15
    pointLight.Parent = rootPart
    pointLight.Name = "FlyLight"
    
    print("Полёт включён! Используйте WASD для движения, Space - вверх, Shift - вниз")
end

-- Функция выключения полёта
local function stopFly()
    if not isFlying then return end
    
    isFlying = false
    
    -- Отключаем невесомость
    humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed)
    humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Falling, true)
    humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping, true)
    
    -- Удаляем эффекты
    if flyConnection then
        flyConnection:Disconnect()
        flyConnection = nil
    end
    
    removeFlyEffects()
    
    -- Удаляем частицы и свет
    local particles = rootPart:FindFirstChild("FlyParticles")
    if particles then
        particles:Destroy()
    end
    
    local light = rootPart:FindFirstChild("FlyLight")
    if light then
        light:Destroy()
    end
    
    print("Полёт выключен")
end

-- Переключение полёта
local function toggleFly()
    if isFlying then
        stopFly()
    else
        startFly()
    end
end

-- Обработка нажатия клавиши
game:GetService("UserInputService").InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if not gameProcessed and input.KeyCode == Settings.ToggleKey then
        toggleFly()
    end
end)

-- GUI
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "FlyGUI"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = player.PlayerGui

local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 100)
mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -100, 0.9, -50)
mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 40)
mainFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
mainFrame.Active = true
mainFrame.Draggable = true
mainFrame.Parent = screenGui

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "✨ Полёт с Огнём ✨"
title.TextColor3 = Settings.FireColor
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextSize = 16
title.Parent = mainFrame

local statusLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
statusLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
statusLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.3, 0)
statusLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
statusLabel.Text = "Статус: Выключен"
statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
statusLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
statusLabel.TextSize = 14
statusLabel.Parent = mainFrame

local toggleButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggleButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 30)
toggleButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.6, 0)
toggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 200)
toggleButton.Text = "Включить (F)"
toggleButton.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
toggleButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
toggleButton.Parent = mainFrame

toggleButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    toggleFly()
end)

-- Обновление статуса
spawn(function()
    while true do
        if isFlying then
            statusLabel.Text = "Статус: Включен"
            statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100)
            toggleButton.Text = "Выключить (F)"

--// ---------- FREE CAM ---------- //
local function stopFreeCam()
    if freeCamConnection then
        freeCamConnection:Disconnect()
        freeCamConnection = nil
    end
    camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
    if player.Character then
        camera.CameraSubject = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    end
end

local function startFreeCam()
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end
    stopFreeCam()
    camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
    local camPos = camera.CFrame.Position
    local camYaw, camPitch = 0, 0
    
    freeCamConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not freeCamEnabled then return end
        if UserInputService.MouseBehavior == Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter then
            local delta = UserInputService:GetMouseDelta()
            camYaw = camYaw - delta.X * 0.003
            camPitch = math.clamp(camPitch - delta.Y * 0.003, -math.rad(89), math.rad(89))
        end
        if fcLookActive and fcLookInput.Magnitude > 0.05 then
            camYaw = camYaw - fcLookInput.X * 0.05
            camPitch = math.clamp(camPitch - fcLookInput.Y * 0.05, -math.rad(89), math.rad(89))
        end
        local rotation = CFrame.Angles(0, camYaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(camPitch, 0, 0)
        local moveDir = Vector3.zero
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then moveDir += rotation.LookVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then moveDir -= rotation.LookVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then moveDir -= rotation.RightVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then moveDir += rotation.RightVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then moveDir += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then moveDir -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
        if fcMoveActive and fcMoveInput.Magnitude > 0.05 then
            moveDir += rotation.LookVector * (-fcMoveInput.Y)
            moveDir += rotation.RightVector * fcMoveInput.X
        end
        if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then moveDir = moveDir.Unit end
        camPos = camPos + moveDir * freeCamSpeed * (1 / 60)
        camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(camPos) * rotation
    end)
end

local function isEnemy(plr)
    if not teamCheckEnabled then return true end
    if not plr.Team then return true end
    if not player.Team then return true end
    return plr.Team ~= player.Team
end

local function teleportToPlayer(target)
    if not target or target == player or not target.Parent then return end
    local myHrp = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local targetHrp = target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myHrp or not targetHrp then return end
    myHrp.CFrame = targetHrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)
    myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    if flying then velocity = Vector3.zero; if bodyVelocity then bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero end end
end

            if billboard and billboard.Parent and billboard.Enabled ~= inRange then billboard.Enabled = inRange end
            if highlight and highlight.Parent and highlight.Enabled ~= inRange then highlight.Enabled = inRange end
            if not inRange then
                if tpBtn and tpBtn.Parent and tpBtn.Visible then tpBtn.Visible = false end
                if tracer and tracer.Parent and tracer.Visible then tracer.Visible = false end
                return

                    tpBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, screenPos.X, 0, screenPos.Y + 55)
                    if not tpBtn.Visible then tpBtn.Visible = true end
                end

            end

                hpBg.Visible = true
                local hp = humanoid.Health / math.max(humanoid.MaxHealth, 1)

                hpFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255 * (1 - hp), 255 * hp, 0)

                local screenSize = camera.ViewportSize
                local startPos = Vector2.new(screenSize.X / 2, screenSize.Y)
                local endPos = Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y)
                local delta = endPos - startPos
                local distance = delta.Magnitude
                local angle = math.atan2(delta.Y, delta.X)
                if tracer and tracer.Parent then
                    if not tracer.Visible then tracer.Visible = true end
                    tracer.Size = UDim2.new(0, distance, 0, 1.5)
                    tracer.Position = UDim2.new(0, (startPos.X + endPos.X) / 2, 0, (startPos.Y + endPos.Y) / 2)
                    tracer.Rotation = math.deg(angle)
                end
            else
                if tracer and tracer.Parent and tracer.Visible then tracer.Visible = false end
            end
        end)
        if not ok then warn("[ESP Loop Error]: " .. tostring(err)) end
    end)

    espConnections[target] = { highlight = highlight, billboard = billboard, tracer = tracer, tpBtn = tpBtn, conn = conn }
end

local function removeESP(target)
    local data = espConnections[target]
    if not data then return end
    if data.highlight then data.highlight:Destroy() end
    if data.billboard then data.billboard:Destroy() end
    if data.tracer then data.tracer:Destroy() end
    if data.tpBtn then data.tpBtn:Destroy() end
    if data.conn then data.conn:Disconnect() end
    espConnections[target] = nil
end

local function clearAllESP()
    for target, _ in pairs(espConnections) do removeESP(target) end
end

local function refreshESP()
    if not espEnabled then return end
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= player and isEnemy(plr) then if plr.Character then createESP(plr) end
        else removeESP(plr) end
    end
end

local function getClosestTargetToCursor()
    local mousePos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    local closest = nil
    local closestDist = aimbotFOV
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= player and isEnemy(plr) then
            local char = plr.Character
            if char then
                local part = char:FindFirstChild(aimbotTargetPart) or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if part and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                    local screenPos, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
                    if onScreen then
                        local dist = (Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y) - mousePos).Magnitude
                        if dist < closestDist then closestDist = dist; closest = part end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return closest
end

    if not aimbotEnabled then return false end

        if shouldAimbotRun() then
            if not aimbotLockedTarget or not aimbotLockedTarget.Parent then aimbotLockedTarget = getClosestTargetToCursor() end
            if aimbotLockedTarget then
                local currentCFrame = camera.CFrame
                local newCFrame = CFrame.new(currentCFrame.Position, aimbotLockedTarget.Position)
                if aimbotSmoothness >= 0.9 then camera.CFrame = newCFrame else camera.CFrame = currentCFrame:Lerp(newCFrame, aimbotSmoothness) end
            end
        else aimbotLockedTarget = nil end
    end
end)

local function updateJoystick(inputPos)
    local center = joystickGui.AbsolutePosition + joystickGui.AbsoluteSize / 2
    local delta = inputPos - center
    local maxDist = joystickGui.AbsoluteSize.X / 2
    if delta.Magnitude > maxDist then delta = delta.Unit * maxDist end
    joyKnob.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, delta.X - JOYSTICK_RADIUS/2, 0.5, delta.Y - JOYSTICK_RADIUS/2)
    joyInput = Vector2.new(delta.X / maxDist, delta.Y / maxDist)

    if joyKnob and joyKnob.Parent then joyKnob.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -JOYSTICK_RADIUS/2, 0.5, -JOYSTICK_RADIUS/2) end

local function makeDraggable(guiObject)
    local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos

    guiObject.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = guiObject.Position
            
            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    dragging = false
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    guiObject.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            dragInput = input
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input == dragInput and dragging then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            guiObject.Position = UDim2.new(
                startPos.X.Scale, 
                startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, 
                startPos.Y.Scale, 
                startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y

    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
    corner.Parent = btn
    
    if keyCode then
        btn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
            pcall(function()
                VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, keyCode, false, game)
            end)
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 200, 100)

        btn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
            pcall(function()
                VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, keyCode, false, game)
            end)
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)
        end)
        
        btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            pcall(function()
                VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, keyCode, false, game)
            end)
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)
        end)
    end
    return btn
end

local activeInput = nil
local knobCenter = Vector2.new(60, 60)
local maxDist = 35

local function resetMovement()
    activeInput = nil
    StickKnob.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -20, 0.5, -20)
    pcall(function()
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.W, false, game)
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.S, false, game)
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.A, false, game)
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.D, false, game)
    end)
end

StickZone.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) and not activeInput then
        activeInput = input
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input == activeInput then
        resetMovement()
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == activeInput and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then
        local absPos = StickZone.AbsolutePosition
        local touchPos = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
        local relPos = touchPos - absPos - knobCenter
        
        if relPos.Magnitude > maxDist then
            relPos = relPos.Unit * maxDist
        end
        
        StickKnob.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, relPos.X - 20, 0.5, relPos.Y - 20)
        
        pcall(function()
            VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(relPos.Y < -8, Enum.KeyCode.W, false, game)
            VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(relPos.Y > 8, Enum.KeyCode.S, false, game)
            VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(relPos.X < -8, Enum.KeyCode.A, false, game)
            VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(relPos.X > 8, Enum.KeyCode.D, false, game)
        end)
    end
end)
